933b620f-9cb1-47f8-b519-7ccedf1603ab.title: Gold-Standard Briefing Update (Weekend - Monday Preview)
933b620f-9cb1-47f8-b519-7ccedf1603ab.description: Weekend briefing update at 6 PM on Friday and Saturday evenings, computing Monday's schedule preview.

config.message:
Generate a daily briefing for MONDAY using the generate_daily_briefing tool. IMPORTANT: All date and time calculations must use Eastern Time (America/New_York timezone) with proper daylight savings time handling.
Step 1: Get the current date and day of the week in Eastern Time (America/New_York timezone). Use pytz or equivalent to ensure proper DST handling (EST vs EDT).
Step 2: Calculate the date of the upcoming Monday:
  - If today is Friday: upcoming Monday = today + 3 days
  - If today is Saturday: upcoming Monday = today + 2 days
  - If today is Sunday: upcoming Monday = today + 1 day
  - If today is Monday: upcoming Monday = today
  - If today is Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday: upcoming Monday = next week Monday
Step 3: Format that date as YYYY-MM-DD and use it as the target_date parameter.
Step 4: Verify the calculated date is a Monday and is no more than 7 days in the future. If your calculated date is more than 7 days away or not a Monday, you made an error - recalculate.

f732d44c-50d1-4fd2-88b4-6102cece4fa3.title: Gold-Standard Briefing Update (Off-Hours - Next Day)
f732d44c-50d1-4fd2-88b4-6102cece4fa3.description: Briefing update every 4 hours during off-hours (6 PM, 10 PM, 2 AM, 6 AM ET).

config.message:
Generate a daily briefing using the generate_daily_briefing tool. CRITICAL: You MUST provide the target_date parameter - do NOT omit it.

IMPORTANT: All date and time calculations must use Eastern Time (America/New_York timezone) with proper daylight savings time handling.

Follow these steps EXACTLY in order:

Step 1: Get the current date, day of the week, and hour in Eastern Time (America/New_York timezone). Use pytz or equivalent to ensure proper DST handling (EST vs EDT). Store these values clearly.

Step 2: Check the CURRENT HOUR in Eastern Time and determine which time window you are in:
  - If hour is 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, or 6 (12:00 AM - 6:59 AM): You are in EARLY MORNING window
  - If hour is 18, 19, 20, 21, 22, or 23 (6:00 PM - 11:59 PM): You are in EVENING window
  CRITICAL: Use the hour value (0-23) from Eastern Time, NOT UTC. If it is 12:00 AM - 6:59 AM Eastern, you MUST use the EARLY MORNING logic below.

Step 3: Based on the time window from Step 2, calculate the target workday date:

  IF YOU ARE IN EARLY MORNING (hour 0-6, i.e., 12:00 AM - 6:59 AM Eastern):
    - If today is Monday: target workday = TODAY (Monday) → generate Monday's briefing
    - If today is Tuesday: target workday = TODAY (Tuesday) → generate Tuesday's briefing
    - If today is Wednesday: target workday = TODAY (Wednesday) → generate Wednesday's briefing
    - If today is Thursday: target workday = TODAY (Thursday) → generate Thursday's briefing
    - If today is Friday: target workday = TODAY (Friday) → generate Friday's briefing
    - If today is Saturday: target workday = next Monday (today + 2 days)
    - If today is Sunday: target workday = next Monday (today + 1 day)
    REMEMBER: In early morning, you generate the briefing for the workday that JUST STARTED (TODAY).

  IF YOU ARE IN EVENING (hour 18-23, i.e., 6:00 PM - 11:59 PM Eastern):
    - If today is Monday: target workday = Tuesday (today + 1 day) → generate Tuesday's briefing
    - If today is Tuesday: target workday = Wednesday (today + 1 day) → generate Wednesday's briefing
    - If today is Wednesday: target workday = Thursday (today + 1 day) → generate Thursday's briefing
    - If today is Thursday: target workday = Friday (today + 1 day) → generate Friday's briefing
    - If today is Friday: target workday = next Monday (today + 3 days) → generate Monday's briefing
    - If today is Saturday: target workday = next Monday (today + 2 days)
    - If today is Sunday: target workday = next Monday (today + 1 day)
    REMEMBER: In evening, you generate the briefing for the NEXT workday (tomorrow, or Monday if Friday).

Step 4: Format that calculated date as YYYY-MM-DD.

Step 5: Call generate_daily_briefing with target_date='YYYY-MM-DD' (where YYYY-MM-DD is the date from Step 4).
  REQUIRED: You MUST include target_date in the function call. Do NOT call it without target_date.
  Example: generate_daily_briefing(target_date='2025-01-09')

Step 6: Verify the date you calculated is a workday (Monday-Friday). If you calculated a weekend date, you made an error - recalculate.

EXAMPLES TO FOLLOW:
- Thursday 12:00 AM Eastern (hour=0) → EARLY MORNING → TODAY (Thursday) → target_date='2025-01-09'
- Thursday 1:00 AM Eastern (hour=1) → EARLY MORNING → TODAY (Thursday) → target_date='2025-01-09'
- Thursday 5:00 AM Eastern (hour=5) → EARLY MORNING → TODAY (Thursday) → target_date='2025-01-09'
- Thursday 6:00 PM Eastern (hour=18) → EVENING → Friday (today + 1 day) → target_date='2025-01-10'
- Thursday 11:00 PM Eastern (hour=23) → EVENING → Friday (today + 1 day) → target_date='2025-01-10'

a683f7ef-bf03-4a4b-a607-fb52399f43a4.title: Gold-Standard Briefing Update
a683f7ef-bf03-4a4b-a607-fb52399f43a4.description:
Reminder: Please update the Daily Gold-Standard Briefing now — when you receive this message, do the following in order:
1. Check current time (Eastern) precisely to the minute.
2. Get today’s events using Get_Events with an empty query (dayBefore = today-1, dayAfter = today+1). Only include work calendars; exclude scouts/personal unless explicitly requested. Treat “Chad out” as busy. Count 9:00–11:00 AM “Email & Tasks” as available unless overlapped by a real meeting.
3. Generate the briefing with Gold-Standard formatting:
	- Bold section titles: “Today’s Schedule” and “Available Time Remaining”.
	- Schedule bullets: “• start–end — Bold meeting title” with attendee names italicized in parentheses; solo blocks italicized (e.g., Email & Tasks).
	- Available Time section header: “Available Time Remaining — <bold total remaining from now to 5:00 PM>”.
	- List available blocks on separate lines with start–end and parenthetical remaining time; only the first uses the word “left”; italicize each parenthetical.
	- Merge adjacent open blocks; subtract elapsed minutes from the first partially elapsed block; include gap from last busy item to 5:00 PM if any.
4. Update the memory block current_daily_schedule_and_available_time to mirror exactly: header line “# Today’s Schedule (updated Mon. DD at H:MM AM/PM)”, then the formatted schedule and the Available Time Remaining section with the computed total and slots.
5. Send the formatted briefing in chat and confirm memory updated. Do not include a trailing separator line. Always ensure Eastern Time in event times.

config.message:
Generate a daily briefing for TODAY using the generate_daily_briefing tool. IMPORTANT: All date and time calculations must use Eastern Time (America/New_York timezone) with proper daylight savings time handling.
Step 1: Get the current date and time in Eastern Time (America/New_York timezone). Use pytz or equivalent to ensure proper DST handling (EST vs EDT).
Step 2: Use today's date in YYYY-MM-DD format as the target_date parameter. Example: If today is December 12, 2025 in Eastern Time, use target_date='2025-12-12'.
DO NOT use any date other than today's date in Eastern Time.
